description: Erection of part two, part three storey 'All Through' Free School with ancillary access, parking, sport pitches and multi-use games area
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The premises shall be used for a school and for no other purpose (including any other purposes in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (listed above) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work on any phase shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Monday to Friday and 0900 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The Construction Method Statement (ref: Method Statement [updated 18th Jan 2016] - Rev A) as approved shall be implemented throughout the construction phase of the development hereby approved.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the commencement of development, a scheme for the protection of the retained trees, in accordance with BS5837:2012 shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include:
a)	A plan to a scale and level of accuracy appropriate to the proposal that shows the position, crown spread and Root Protection Area of every tree on site in relation to the approved plans and particulars. The positions of all trees to be removed shall be indicated on this plan.
b)	A schedule of tree works for all the retained trees, specifying pruning and other remedial or preventative work, whether for physiological, hazard abatement, aesthetic or operational reasons.  All the tree work shall be carried out in accordance with BS3998:2010 - Tree Work - Recommendations.
c)	The details and positions (shown on plan at paragraph (a) above) of the Tree Protection Barriers, identified separately where required for different phases of construction work.  The Tree Protection Barriers must be erected prior to each phase of construction commencing and remain in place, and undamaged for the duration of that phase.  No works shall take place on the next phase until the Tree Protection Barriers are repositioned for that phase.
d)	The details and positions of any underground service runs shall be shown on the plan required at paragraph (a).
The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree or hedge shall be carried out in complete accordance with BS5837:2012, before any equipment, machinery, or materials are brought onto the site for the purposes of development or other operations.  The fencing shall be retained intact for the full duration of the development until all equipment, materials and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  If the fencing is damaged all operations shall cease until it is repaired in accordance with the approved details.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any fenced area in accordance with this

Condition : 8 - In accordance with the phasing strategy, as approved under condition 3, a construction specification/method statement for the delivery of any aspect of the development hereby permitted, falling within 5m of the Root Protection Area, approved under condition 8, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, prior to the works being undertaken.  The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 10 - For the avoidance of doubt, all window and door reveals shall be of a minimum depth of 100mm, excluding curtain walling which shall have a minimum reveal of 10mm.

Condition : 11 - In accordance with the phasing strategy, as approved under condition 3, a scheme for the foul and surface water drainage of the site, achieving Greenfield run off rates shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the strategy approved.

Condition : 12 - In accordance with the phasing strategy, as approved under condition 3, details of both the hard and soft landscaping proposals shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall include:
 	soft planting: including any grass and turf areas, trees, planters, shrub and herbaceous areas including details of species, sizes and numbers/densities; 
 	proposed finished levels or contours:: including earthworks, ground finishes, top soiling with both conserved and imported topsoil(s), levels, drainage and fall in drain types;   
 	hard landscaping: including ground surfaces, kerbs, edges, ridge and flexible pavings, unit paving, furniture, steps, 'visual thread'  and if applicable synthetic surfaces for both ground level 
 	any external lighting; and
 	any other landscaping feature(s) forming part of the scheme. 
All landscaping in accordance with the approved scheme shall be completed / planted during the first planting season following completion of construction works. The submission shall include a management programme for a period of 10 years.
Any trees or shrubs planted which die within five years of completion of the development shall be replaced with the same species, and of comparable maturity, or an approved alternative. The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 13 - In accordance with the phasing strategy, as approved under condition 3, details of the proposed cycle parking and enclosures, to accommodate a minimum of 175 pupil spaces and 22 staff spaces, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cycle parking shall be installed and made available for use in accordance with the details approved prior to occupation of the school buildings and thereafter retained throughout the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 14 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on the approved drawings shall be constructed, in accordance with the parking phasing plan shown on plan ref LA-WS-L-90-12 Rev C and available for use before first occupation of the relevant part of the development that use those facilities and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.
Condition : 15 - For the avoidance of doubt, the finished floor levels shall be set 150mm above local ground levels.

Condition : 16 - Prior to the first use of the new access to Syon Lane, shown on plans reference 8687/001 Rev D and 8687/002 Rev B, the existing access shall be temporarily closed and remain unused thereafter. Prior to the first use of the school, hereby approved, the existing access shall be permanently closed and the footpath reinstated.

Condition : 17 - Prior to the first use of the school hereby permitted, the accesses from Wood Lane shall be completed and made available for their intended use, as shown on plan reference LA-WS-L-90-11 Rev C.  The accesses shall be retained in an accessible manner thereafter.
Condition : 18 - Entry and exit signage to each of the two vehicular accesses to the site shall be provided prior to occupation of school hereby permitted and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 19 - The measures and procedures for monitoring and review set out within the submitted Travel Plan ref. 8571/003/09dated 14 October 2015 shall be implemented during the operational phase of the development and maintained throughout the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 20 - 21.	Within 3 months of ground works starting on site, a BREEAM Interim (Design Stage) Certificate, issued by the Building Research Establishment (BRE) or equivalent licensing organisation, must be submitted for the school building to the Local Planning Authority to show that a minimum 61% 'Very Good' rating will be achieved.

Condition : 21 - Within 3 months of completion of the development a BREEAM Final (Post-Construction) Certificate, issued by the BRE or equivalent licensing organisation, must be submitted for the school building to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that 61% 'Very Good' has been achieved. All the measures integrated, shall be retained for as long as the development is in existence.

Condition : 22 - Prior to the first use of the school hereby permitted, a Community Use Agreement, including, but not limited to: 
 	travel plan measures, 
 	draft contractual arrangements, 
 	availability of space(s) for use within the School for individual members of the community and community groups;
timings of availability of the space(s) to be made available
a strategy for marketing and advertising of the available space(s);
shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The school shall thereafter operate in accordance with that Agreement.

Condition : 23 - Prior to the first use of the school hereby permitted, a Service and Delivery Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The school shall thereafter operate in accordance with the approved Plan.

Condition : 24 - In accordance with plan ref: LA-WS-L-90-15 Rev D, 17 active and 9 passive Electric Vehicle Charging Points (EVCP) within the car park area hereby approved shall be installed and active EVCP points fully operational before the first use of the school and thereafter maintained.

Condition : 25 - In accordance with the phasing strategy, as approved under condition 3, details of any external plant to be installed on the relevant building(s) hereby approved shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such details shall include any necessary sound reduction strategy/mitigation measures. No further fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the written prior approval of the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 26 - No part of the development shall be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the submitted Energy Statement and a reduction of 35% in CO2 emissions against Part L 2013 has been achieved in accordance with London Plan policies. The development shall be heated be a communal heating system served by a single plant room.

Condition : 27 - No part of the development shall be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the recommendations contained within the Ecology Survey Report (Ref: JSL2380_871c) dated October 2014 and the Extended Phase 1 Survey (Richard Graves Associates) dated July '15. All the measures integrated, shall be retained for as long as the development is in existence.

Condition : 28 - During the course of the development:
a) The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess any such additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.
Before the development is first brought into use:
b) The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clause a) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 29 - Prior to the first occupation of the building hereby permitted, the highway works to Syon Lane shown on plans 8687/001 Rev D and 8687/002 Rev B shall be completed and made available for use.
Condition : 30 - Prior to the first occupation of the school hereby permitted, the highway works as generally shown on plan Ref 8571-006 Rev A, shall be implemented and made available for use.

Condition : 31 - No development or demolition shall take place other than in accordance with the agreed stage 1 written scheme of investigation (WSI) hereby approved (by CgMS dated November 2015 (revised December 2015). For land that is included within the WSI, no demolition or development shall take place other than in accordance with the agreed WSI, and the programme and methodology of site evaluation and the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works. 
If heritage assets of archaeological interest are identified by Stage 1 then for those parts of the site which have archaeological interest, a Stage 2 WSI shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority in writing.  For land that is included within the Stage 2 WSI, no demolition/development shall take place other than in accordance with the agreed Stage 2 WSI which shall include:
A.	The statement of significance and research objectives, the programme and methodology of site investigation and recording and the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works
B.	The programme for post-investigation assessment and subsequent analysis, publication & dissemination and deposition of resulting material. this part of the condition shall not be discharged until these elements have been fulfilled in accordance with the programme set out in the Stage 2 WSI.
